parent_objective: design a fair controller-family decisive evidence matrix after current-state audit
blocked_by: standard profile evidence does not support history necessity or L3 advantage
exact-residual artifact route failed first closed-loop replay checks
controller-family ranking on decisive-history tasks is missing

public_gates: M1670 must design a controller-family matrix covering L0 L1 L2 L2-current-tiled L3 and L3 reset controls
M1670 must separate standard profile evidence from decisive-history and clean active-set evidence
M1670 must define public pilot budgets and stop rules before implementation
M1670 must not assume online GRU superiority
M1670 must keep training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact
do not tune one profile separately

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the M1669 current-state audit into a pre-registered controller-family decisive evidence matrix
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design assumes GRU superiority before evidence
stop if L2 current-tiled or L3 reset controls are omitted
stop if standard-profile evidence is mixed with decisive-history evidence without labels
stop if public clean active-set rows are treated as private holdout evidence
stop if profile-specific tuning is admitted
fallback_plan: route to profile-config repair if corrected profiles cannot be instantiated
route to task-family audit if decisive-history artifacts cannot be mapped to controller profiles
route to negative or conditional paper story if the design finds current-response or finite-window controls are sufficient
route to high-fidelity future simulator only after current-sim controller-family evidence is exhausted
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1669 routes from current-state audit into the next paper-route design branch

admission_evidence: M1498 stopped standard profile scaling after negative L2/L3 controls
M1615 provides a clean public active-set proof package
M1668 closed exact-residual artifact repair after closed-loop replay failure
M1669 identifies controller-family decisive evidence as the missing paper-route experiment
allowed_updates: M1670 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if design admits implementation or audit
next_stage_criteria: controller profile list and fairness rules are explicit
task families and artifact sources are explicit
public pilot budgets and stop rules are explicit
next implementation or audit route is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1670 exists to keep L1 current-response and L2 current-tiled controls in the decisive matrix.
history_necessity_tests: design must include L0 current, L1 one-step, L2 finite-window, L2 current-tiled, L3 online-GRU, and L3 reset/truncated controls
design must include decisive-history or clean active-set tasks where current-frame substitution is explicitly tested
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1497 standard profiles plus M1499-M1669 decisive-history and clean active-set public evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the designed matrix later shows current-response or finite-window controls match L3, record a negative or conditional recurrent-self-ID result rather than weakening the claim standard.
allowed_claims: controller-family matrix design and route decision
no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A controller-family decisive evidence matrix can be designed from existing standard-profile, decisive-history, clean active-set, and artifact-failure evidence without assuming GRU superiority.
success_criteria: design specifies L0 L1 L2 L2-current-tiled L3 and L3-control families
design separates standard profile tasks from decisive-history and clean active-set tasks
design specifies public pilot budgets metrics and stop rules
design blocks profile-specific tuning and private holdout
design chooses a concrete next implementation or audit route
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: design omits current-response finite-window current-tiled or reset controls
design treats public clean rows as private holdout
design routes directly to PPO promotion private holdout or paper evidence
decision_rule: M1670 passes if it designs the fair controller-family decisive evidence matrix and chooses the next route before implementation, training, replay, PPO, promotion, or private holdout.
